reviews.title: Does not work in B550 MB if second m2 slot is filled
reviews.comment:
I'm giving this card four stars because I'm assuming it works well. But be aware, if you have a B550 motherboard with the second m2 slot filled, and you are using this as a second card in the PCIe 3 slot, it will not work. These two slots share bandwidth and are either/or, not both/and. Since I run two m2 drives, it would not work for me.
I think it would be a good idea for the manufacturer to warn people about this. Many people pick up cheaper cards to add an extra monitor, and a warning would save time, returns, and making new equipment open box for no reason.
reviews.author: Paul B.

reviews.title: Card by SOYO?
reviews.comment:
Inside the MOUGOL box was a graphics card labeled as a SOYO. 🤔 Just a card, no documentation or ATI CD.  Works well in my i7-4867 with 16 gig and Samsung 32" monitor. Once I found the right drivers for Win 8.1.
What was puzzling that with each free GPU app I used was the information about the card. Some said 4 gig onboard, others said 1 gig. The card identification was never the same on each app. GPU Z showed to correct configuration, I think.
Easy plug in, was impressed with the dust covers on the HDMI ports and plug in component.  Might be a bit over priced at $59 by about $15.  Heard negative things about SOYO but so far it's working well.
reviews.author: Thomas Paul
